title: Proof of Loss Time Limits, Asset-Based Long-Term Care Life Insurance
content:
**Proof of loss.** Under every Ashgrove CareAssure tier of Asset-Based Long-Term Care Life Insurance, expenses for a month of care should be submitted within the proof of loss period, counted in calendar days after the end of that month of care. The latest submission period is the outer limit after the end of a month of care, absent legal incapacity.

| Tier | Proof of loss period (calendar days after the end of the month of care) | Latest submission, absent legal incapacity (calendar days after the end of the month of care) |
|---|---|---|
| Ashgrove CareAssure 2-Year | 90 | 365 |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 3-Year | 90 | 365 |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 4-Year | 90 | 365 |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 5-Year | 90 | 365 |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 6-Year | 90 | 365 |
| Ashgrove CareAssure Lifetime | 90 | 365 |

**Timing bands for one month of care (all tiers)**

| Submitted, counting calendar days after the end of the month of care | Position |
|---|---|
| Up to and including day 90 | Within the proof of loss period |
| Day 91 to day 365 | After the proof of loss period, not more than 365 days after the month of care |
| Day 366 or later | More than 365 days after the month of care: not paid unless the claimant lacked legal capacity |

**Illustration (hypothetical month of care).** For care received in a hypothetical month of care ending on 30 June 2026, the 90-day period runs to 28 September 2026, and day 365 falls on 30 June 2027. Expenses submitted on 30 June 2027 are not more than 365 days after the month of care; expenses submitted on 1 July 2027 are.
